transforms: Only diagnostic IPs, hostnames, private paths and experiment unit tags are consistently remapped; numeric samples are unchanged.
Client JSON plaintext is byte-for-byte preserved; gzip is recompressed at level 9 with mtime 0. The decompressed SHA-256 inventory binds all 11520 formal sample files.
Runtime source and executed tool archives retain original content and hashes; never execute tools from the evidence archive.
Derived CSV uses LF line endings; captured control logs are gzip-compressed without trimming their text.
scope: Medians of correlated 60-second windows, not pooled percentiles or independent repetitions. Sampled CPU/RSS include setup and warmup. First-to-last leader counter intervals also include probes and gaps. Lifetime maxima cannot be differenced into window maxima.
